node.title: H3 non-swap collisions are a directed quotient-line chord moment
node.statement: Put C_m={a in A:ma in A}, so |C_m|=R(m). The exact non-swap collision multiplicity Q(t)=P(t)(P(t)-2)+D(t) equals the number of triples (m,a,a') with m!=1, a!=a', a,a' in C_m, and m*a*a'=t. Hence S_ns=sum_{m!=1}sum_{a!=a' in C_m,maa'!=1}R(maa'), while S_ns^rich restricts the inner sum to P(maa')>=19. This is a proved bijection and re-poses C36' as a directed source-line/target-line correlation; it does not assert the open 1200n^2 rich-moment bound. Two complete symbolic fences reject an automatic non-base target in the natural Laurent-monomial ansatz and every direct coordinate-permutation embedding of the six subgroup variables into one classical collinear-triple equation.
